en: Let's go to Heena.
I ran into Heena who was worrying about her face getting irritated by the strong sunlight. I have to get a mirror for Heena from her sister, Sarah.

en: Let's start looking for Biggs.

I met Biggs at Southperry. He asked me if I can get him 10 orange mushroom caps and 30 blue snail shells and that he'll reward me with a nice item if I do so. He doesn't look too convinced that I can do this, but... it looks like a piece of cake to me.

en: A kind guy on Maple Island, Sam wanted to give me some Beginner advice...who says beginners aren't lucky?

Sam taught me How to use AP which I can get whenever my level gets up. The investment of  AP determines my power (STR), intelligence (INT), agility (DEX), luck (LUK). My investment choice of AP will increase my HP and MP. \n\nwhoa.. Fantastic! I learned a lot thanks to him. Sam said there is one more thing to tell me.

Sam told me to go to Victoria Island if I want to be a stronger adventurer through a Job Advancement. I can choose from a Warrior, a Magician, a Bowman, a Thief and a Pirate on Victoria Island. Each job has a stat requirement to join and train on that path: Warrior is STR 35, Magician INT 20, Bowman DEX 25, Thief DEX 25. I'll remember that and invest AP in the proper stats of the job i want!
zh: 彩虹岛上有位善良的山姆，想给我一些新手建议……谁说新手运气不好了？

山姆教我怎么使用每次升级都会获得的能力点(AP)。加点方向决定我的力量(STR)、智力(INT)、敏捷(DEX)和幸运(LUK)。加点方式还会影响我的 HP 与 MP。

哇……太棒了！托他的福学到很多。山姆说还有一件事要告诉我。
山姆说，如果我想通过转职成为更强的冒险家，就去金银岛。在金银岛上可以从战士、魔法师、弓箭手、飞侠、海盗中选择职业。每种职业都有加入并修炼所需的能力要求：战士要求 STR 35、魔法师要求 INT 20、弓箭手要求 DEX 25、飞侠要求 DEX 25。我会记住，并把 AP 加到想选职业对应的能力上！

en: I'm at a crossroads. Where should I go? I should've seen the sign. Hhhhh! Let's ask Maria for help.
Maria showed me how to read the World Map. If I press W, the world map will appear. I can see some places that I haven't been...

en: Maple World, where fantasy and reality meet and have pie! This is the world where many people are eager to listen to my own story. I better go talk to Heena first.
Heena told me her sister Sera also likes to meet with new travelers, and wanted me to go see her. Apparently, Sera's near by, hanging laundry. I better head right.
Sera told me to take the portal on the right and move forward.

希娜说她的姐姐莎丽也想见见新的旅行家，让我去见见莎丽。她说莎丽就在不远的地方晒衣服，快去右边见见她吧。
莎丽让我通过右边的传送点继续前进。

en: At the East entrance of the Mushroom Town, there's a fella named Todd who can teach me how to hunt in the world of Maple. I better go see him right now.

Todd instructed me that the Ctrl key allows me to hunt in a basic manner, and told me to hunt the Jr. Sentinel nearby. I should hunt Jr. Sentinel, grab 1 piece of Jr. Sentinel Shellpiece and bring them to Peter to learn hunting methods using skills. 

Jr. Sentinel #a1#   

#i4031802# #t4031802# #c4031802#/1

I have learned that skills can be accessed through pressing K to open the skill window, and unlike regular attacks, skills can only be accessed by raising the skill level by assigning skill points. He also told me that it's much easier to use the skill by saving it on the Quick Slot. I better do that.

托德教我：按 Ctrl 键可以进行基础攻击，还让我去猎附近的见习哨兵。我应该猎见习哨兵，拿 1 片见习哨兵壳片，去找彼得学习用技能狩猎的方法。

见习哨兵 #a1#   

#i4031802# #t4031802# #c4031802#/1
我学会了：按 K 键可以打开技能窗口；与普通攻击不同，技能要分配技能点提升等级后才能使用。他还说，把技能放到快捷栏会更方便。最好照做。

A time in the past where one can travel to through the broken Gate of Time. Fairy of Ellin Forest is awaiting a hero who will one day save the polluted forest. But...should anyone interfere with history?

 - #eTime Limit#n : 30 minutes
 - #eNumber of Participants#n : 3 ~ 5 people

en: I heard that Blackbull is fixing his house...

Right here, in this dusty town of Perion, I ran into an oddly-dressed man named Blackbull. He told me he needs to fix is house and wondered if I could help him out by getting him 30 tree branches and 50 firewoods. If I do him a favor, I get myself a nice shield that he has, but what if I say no? I wouldn't ... be ... EATEN BY HIM ... no?? I really hope not...

I got Blackbull of Perion 30 tree branches and 50 firewoods. With these, he can finally fix his house. I got this shield as a reward ... and ... well, scratchmarks here and there, and it looks pretty old ... is this even usable?

en: I heard that "Blackbull" in Perion is building a new house...

I ran into "Blackbull" again, the guy I helped fix his house. He was surprised at how strong I looked, and asked me for a much harder favor. His cousins from Henesys are all trying to move to Perion, and so he needed to build a new house! To build a new house, he said he needed 100 pieces of rock from Stone Golem, 30 screws, 30 processed wood, and Blackbull's deed to the land. His son had the deed to the land, only to have it stolen by Curse Eye neaer Sleepywood...hmmm...I should be looking for those wandering around the deep forest...

To move all of "Blackbull"'s cousins to Perion, I got him all the items he requested: 100 pieces of rock from Stone Gollem, 30 screws, 30 refined wood, and 1 deed to the land. I got him all these...and yet what if he asks me to actually BUILD a house for him next time up?? Anyway for that, he gave me a little bit of EXP, 15,000 mesos, and a scroll for weapon with 10% success rate. Even my fame went up +2...not bad...

en: I hear that #p1012101# is very sick...

I met this girl named Maya at the old, raggedy townstreet of Henesys. She's been suffering from illness for a long time, so she doesn't look too well to even live a normal life. Weird Medicine... what a strange name, and she said she'll get a little bit better by taking that... I better go to Lith Harbor and see this guy Teo...
Maya wanted me to go see Teo of Lith Harbor, so I did just that. He promised to give me the Weird Medicine only after I get him a Sparkling Rock.
zh: 听说射手村的玛亚生病了。
在射手村的小旧屋里见了叫玛亚的女孩子。她看起来有得了顽疾不能正常生活。她说如果有一种叫"奇怪的药"(名字真奇怪)就可以好一点…为了她我要去明珠港见一个叫特奥的水手。
接受射手村马亚的拜托后去明珠港见了特奥，但他说我给他闪耀的石头他才可以给我奇怪的药...

en: Around "The Victoria" in Lith Harbor, I met this heavily-bearded crewmember called Teo. He said he has the Weird Medicine but he wasn't willing to give it up for free. Instead he said he'll trade with me for a sparkling rock. I mean, he does look like he knows Maya pretty well, but he still wants to make a deal with me, knowing how sick she is ...?? That's strange... anyway, to get that sparkling rock, I need to head over to Perion and talk to the Sophia, the daughter of the owner of the department store there.
I finally met Sophia, who's working at the department store in Perion. To make the sparkling rock, she said she needs Arcon's blood.
zh: 在明珠港的金银号附近见了特奥。他是胡子很多的人。他说有是有那种药，但不能白给我。要是我给他会发光的石头，他就可以交给我那药。看起来他已经很熟悉玛亚，而且他已经知道玛亚的病，但怎么能提要求呢？真是奇怪的人... 我为了拿到发光的石头要去见勇士部落杂货店的索非亚。
我为了找可以做闪耀的石头的索非亚区永世不落了。她说有一些材料她就可以做那个石头...

en: Around "The Victoria" in Lith Harbor, I met this heavily-bearded crewmember called Teo. He said he has the #bWeird Medicine#k but he wasn't willing to give it up for free. Instead he said he'll trade with me for a #bsparkling rock#k. I mean, he does look like he knows Maya pretty well, but he still wants to make a deal with me, knowing how sick she is ...?? That's strange... anyway, to get that #bsparkling rock#k, I need to head over to Perion and talk to the #rSophia#k, the daughter of the owner of the department store there.
I finally met Sophia, who's working at the department store in Perion. To make the sparkling rock, she said she needs #bArcon's blood#k.

zh.note: 第三方官方语料（国服译名/原版阶段文本），待抽审

en: I finally met Sophia, who's working on her dream as an alchemist inside the department store in Perion. To make the sparkling rock, she said she needs 50 squishy liquid's, 50 leaves, 20 octopus legs and 1 Arcon's blood. Everything else looks reasonable enough except ... Arcon's blood ...??? Fortunately, Sophia knew where to get it. She told me to look for this man named Manji somewhere around Perion. Manji, huh ... where must he be ... ??
Sophia told me that Manji has the Arcon's Blood, which is what the sparkling rock is made of.
zh: 在杂货店里见到了索非亚。她是想成为炼金术士的小姐。她告诉我为制作发光的石头需要50个绿液球，50个叶子，20个三眼章鱼触角，一瓶变异蘑菇的血。别的东西不难得到…但是变异蘑菇的血是什么呢？幸亏索非亚告诉我在勇士部落某个地方住着一个叫麦吉的男人肯定知道。叫麦吉... 他在哪里？
索非亚说麦吉知道怎么能得到变异蘑菇的血。

I'm starting to regret saying yes to Maya in the first place ...
Manji asked for the Charms of the Undead in return to Arcon's Blood.

en: I traded the sparkling rock with Teo of Lith Harbor for the weird medicine. Now, all I need to do is get this to Maya, and I'm done, but the more I think about it, the more I regret saying yes. Anyway, this medicine looks quite tasty. If I ever find myself thirsty and without any water, maybe I should just drink it myself. Hahaha...

I went back to Henesys and handed Maya the weird medicine.  Hopefully she'll get better after taking this. As a sign of thanks, Maya got me 5,000 mesos and a brown bamboo hat. This hat ... I mean, it looks like it's going to help when I'm walking under a blazing sun, but it looks so old and raggedy ... and if I put it on, it makes this weird noise that feels as if some insect is walking around and stuff ... am I going to be alright ... ???

到射手村给了玛亚奇怪的药。有这个玛亚的毛病可能治好吧？玛亚为了向我表示感谢给了我5000金币和褐色斗笠。这个斗笠….在太阳晒得太厉害的时候可以戴，但看起来很旧的样子。说不定里面有虫子…戴这个帽子没问题吗？

en: Let's go look for Jane at Lith Harbor.

At around Lith Harbor near "The Victoria", I met this girl name Jane, who was sporting bunny ears. Jane expressed a desire to travel around the island, but her father just wouldn't let her. She thought if she got a hold of 80 wild boar teeth and 100 horny mushroom caps, then maybe her father would let her go afterall. And for that, she asked me if I could get her those ... I mean, isn't SHE supposed to collect them herself? Anyway it doesn't sound too hard, so I should headover to the highland and start hunting down some wild boars ...

I got Jane 80 wild boar teeth and 100 horny mushroom caps that she requested. Seriously, though, will her dad approve of her traveling with this? Not with the bunny ears she's wearing ... hmm ... anyway, in return, she got me something she's been keeping for a long time: a scroll for weapon for ATT. If this works, then... my weapon's going to be awesome!!

en: I heard there is a runaway kid called Alex in Kerning City...

At the top of the building in Kerning City, I met this kid named Alex, who looked like a runaway kid. He left home a few days ago aftter a spat with his father. He'd been wandering around Kerning City ever since, but now, with no money and a severe case of boredom hitting him, he just wanted to go back home ... with the problem being that he was certain that a whole round of spanking would await him if he did, indeed, return home. So he asked me if I could convince his father Stan, who happened to be the chief of Henesys, to let him return home without any incident. Not only that, he asked me to get his late mother's article, her old gold watch, from him as a proof. If he had known this would happen, would he have done it nonetheless?
As Alex has requested, I looked for his father in Henesys to get Alex's mother's old gold watch.
zh: 听说在废弃都市有离家出走的小孩子
在废弃都市见到了叫阿勒斯的男孩子。他说几天前因为和严历的父亲闹别扭他离家出走了，此后就在废弃都市游荡。现在不但钱也都花光了，而且已经觉得无聊了... 但是现在回家可能父亲要打他…他拜托我说服射手村的长老(他父亲)同意他回家。他还说如果我成功说服他父亲，就拿着母亲的遗物-金表过来，他才可以相信。我不知道他为什么离家出走~！
接受阿勒斯的拜托后我为了见他父亲去射手村了.

en: At the entrance of Henesys Park, I met Alex's father Stan, the chief of Henesys. I couldn't even start up a conversation with him at first, but once I got him 50 Evil Eye's tails and 100 pig ribbons he requested to fix this town, that was when he decided to listen. en: I heard that Arwen the fairy from Ellinia has lost something...

Arwen the fairy from Ellinia told me that a couple of days ago, on the way to Perion, she was attacked by a monster covered in flame, and lost her very precious glass shoe in the process. Fairies love glimmering, shiny objects to the point of obsession, so obviously she wants it back badly ... I better hunt some monsters around Perion, and hopefully I can find it there.

I got Arwen from Ellinia the glass shoe she desperately wanted back. I got lucky, finding it from a nasty Fireboar ... phew. Anyway, as a sign of gratitude, she gave me a fairy item. It's really gorgeous and glimmering like a star ... dang, maybe I can use this to make something special ...
zh: 听说魔法密林的艾温丢了什么...
魔法密林叫艾温的妖精告诉我，她几天前去勇士部落的路上受到了全身都是火焰的怪物的攻击。那怪物抢走了她贵重的玻璃鞋。妖精族非常喜欢那样闪闪发光的东西，所以她很想找回来。在勇士部落打怪物的话，说不定可以找回艾温的玻璃鞋。
我找到那贵重的玻璃鞋后还给了魔法密林的艾温。从很凶猛的火野猪那里抢来了这双玻璃鞋，我是很幸运的啊！艾温表示感谢，给我妖精族的物品。非常漂亮而且闪闪发光的东西！用这个物品也许能做很特别的物品吧？

en: Let's meet Luke the Security Guy at the entrance of the Henesys Dungeon.

At the entrance of the dungeon, I met Luke the security guy. He wanted to make a healthy dish for his mom, and asked me if I could get him 100 pieces of Jr. Necki's skin, 10 wings of Stirge, and a bowl of salad. name.en: "Mar" the Fairy and the Water of Life
name.zh: 妖精 玛丽和生命水

en: At Ellinia, I ran into a fairy that's been busily studying the magic of life. Her name is "Mar" and after taking a look at my pet that's been turned into a doll, she told me she can make it come back alive with The Water of Life and The Scroll of Life. I heard that she knows Cloy of Henesys... since it looks like a pet trainer named Trainer Bartos of Henesys knows something about the scroll of life, I should head over there...

After easily passing the test from Trainer Bartos of Henesys, I got a hold of The Water of Life and The Scroll of Lifel, and got that to "Mar" the fairy. With her magical power and the items I got her, she turned the doll back into a living pet. I can hang out with him for a while longer now ... sweet ...

en: Let's go look for Sabitrama in Sleepywood.

I should go there and talk to this guy Shane ...

en: What do I have to do to choose a job of my liking? I'll have to see Olaf of Lith Harbor.
I'll have to listen to #p1002101# carely as he describes the in's and out's of each and every job, because he'll quiz me on it afterwards.

I answered all the questions #p1002101# asked. I'll have to be at least on level 10 in order to become a a Warrior, a Thief, a Bowman, or a Pirate, and level 8 to become a Magician. Warrior-hopefuls will need to head over to Perion for job-advancement, Kerning City for thief-hopefuls, Ellinia for magician-hopefuls, and Henesys for Bowman-hopefuls.
zh: 要怎么样才能选择职业呢？去明珠港找坤问问好了。
要到明珠港，听坤所提出的职业相关说明后解决问题。
已将坤的职业要关问题全部解答完毕！若要选择战士、弓箭手、飞侠须达到等级10，而想要成为法师只需达到等级 8即可。战士需在勇士部落进行转职，而弓箭手则是射手村、飞侠是在废弃都市、法师是在魔法密林才能进行转职。

en: Ayan of Perion says she can't take one step out of town. I wonder why...

I met Ayan of Perion. Apparently, she cannot remember anything about her childhood, and she lives everyday in fear of Stumps. So scared, in fact, that she can't even dare to look at it. Accompanied by this paralyzing fear of Stumps, she cannot take one step out of Perion, and asks me to take them out for her sake. Are they really THAT scary? \n\n#o0130100# #a20821#
I took out Stumps for the sake of Ayan in Perion. She can finally venture outside without having to worry about them!
zh: 听说住在勇士部落的伊安无法踏出村庄一步…
见到了住在勇士部落的伊安，她虽然没有纯正的印第安血统，但仍住在勇士部落。也许她曾经经历过痛苦的事情，使得她完全没有小时候的记忆。她非常害怕木妖，听说看着木妖得眼睛，就会感到莫名的恐惧…因为这股莫名的恐惧而无法踏出村庄的她，拜托我帮她打倒木妖…木妖有这么可怕吗？ 木妖 #a20821#
替居住在勇士部落的伊安打倒了木妖，但愿从此以后她可以安心的到村外走走。

name.en: The Reason Behind the Mushroom Studies

en: I should go see Bruce in Henesys...

I got to meet Bruce, who has been studying the monsters and animals in general in Henesys. His bright smile and the easy-going demeanor belies the painful fact that his daughter has been missing for some time, and that he's been studying the mushroom monsters for the sake of finding a clue on his daughter's whereabouts. He asks me if I can help him out, and I just can't say no to a worthy cause like this...

#t4000011# #c4000011#/10 
#t4000001# #c4000001#/40
I helped Bruce gather up the materials necessary for his studies. Will these help him find his daughter?

Finally, the Whalian Prince has been replenished with mana. I thought he was just an ordinary dolphin... I mean, who would have known that he could turn out to be such a handsome prince?

en: Baine's job is to monitor the sound waves of The Nautilus. The way the ship sounds is a good indicator of the overall well-being of the ship. Recently, Baine had apparently detected a strange sound coming through the walls on the lower deck. Could this be an ominous sign of things to come?

When Baine detects the strange sound waves coming from The Nautilus, he asks Bart, the  keeper of the Watchtower, whether he's noticed any changes in sight. The watchtower is apparently on the eastern end of the shipping dock so I'd better look around carefully.

It sounds like someone is calling out my name. The dreamy eyes... the luscious purple hair... who are you?

The fairy with the dreamy eyes... and the luscious purple hair talked for a bit, but it wasn't understandable at all. After the fairy disappeared, I found a Mysterious Small Egg inside my inventory. Didn't she say something about it being my friend...? Anyway, better go visit the fairy at Ellinia, the town of Fairies.\r\n<Message from the Fairy>\nThe purple bellflower that soaks in the sun in between the skyscraping trees...Follow the path to the unknown that leads you to the bellflower. I will wait for you here.

The fairy with the dreamy eyes... and the luscious purple hair talked for a bit, but it wasn't understandable at all. After the fairy disappeared, I found a Mysterious Small Egg inside my inventory. Reliving the message the Fairy left for me, I went to the area and found Mar the Fairy hiding behind a huge bellflower. Mar mentioned something about being responsible for taking care of a living being, and then gave me a pet as a gift. The mysterious small egg turned out to be a Snail's egg.\r\nAlong with a message that this small snail can only be with me for 5 hours.
zh: 貌似有谁在呼唤我，如处于梦境般的眼神…紫色头发…你是谁?
如处于梦境般的眼神…紫色头发的妖精留下了完全没有头绪的话语，就悄然消失了。妖精消失后，口袋里多了个迷之小蛋。据说这会是我的朋友…先按照妖精告诉我的那般，去妖精们的村庄魔法密林吧。 无法衡量高度的绿色树木的故乡，含着光的紫色风铃草…无法确信的未知的路，找到它并跟随它。我会在那里等你。
如处于梦境般的眼神…紫色头发的妖精，某天突然出现在了我的面前。 妖精留下了完全没有头绪的话语，就悄然消失了。妖精消失后，口袋里多了个迷之小蛋。追寻妖精留下的线索，找到了藏身于魔法密林风铃草里的玛丽。玛丽讲述了生命和责任相关的内容并送了我一只宠物。先前那谜之小蛋就是蜗牛的卵。同时玛丽还说 这只小蜗牛只能陪伴你5小时.

en: It sounds like someone is calling out my name. The dreamy eyes... the luscious purple hair... who are you?

The fairy with the dreamy eyes... and the luscious purple hair talked for a bit, but it wasn't understandable at all. After the fairy disappeared, I found a #bMysterious Small Egg#k inside my inventory. Didn't she say something about it being my friend...? Anyway, better go visit the fairy at #bEllinia#k, the town of Fairies.\r\n#b<Message from the Fairy>\nThe purple bellflower that soaks in the sun in between the skyscraping trees...Follow the path to the unknown that leads you to the bellflower. I will wait for you here.

The fairy with the dreamy eyes... and the luscious purple hair talked for a bit, but it wasn't understandable at all. After the fairy disappeared, I found a Mysterious Small Egg inside my inventory. Reliving the message the Fairy left for me, I went to the area and found Mar the Fairy hiding behind a huge bellflower. Mar mentioned something about being responsible for taking care of a living being, and then gave me a pet as a gift. The mysterious small egg turned out to be a Snail's egg.\r\nAlong with a message that this small snail can only be with me for 5 hours.

en: A middle-aged gentleman who laims to have been the leader of a Family for 30 mind-boggling years... the rumors about this man, Captain Al, who can be found in Lith Harbor and Orbis Park, are running rampant. What exactly is a Family and the Leader anyway? It sounds interesting... better ask Captain Al that question myself.
Captain Al seemed much more pleasant the rumors suggested. I have a lot to ask... and he said ask him when I'm ready. How about now?

Captain Al's passion for adventure the Family are palpable. Forget the tear-jerking adventures of Captain Al; I'm more interested in the concept of the Family... \nFortunately, Captain Al told me to ask him anytime about the Family. Should I become a Leader myself? Well, first I'll need to find a Junior I can support.
zh: 说自己曾经在长达30年的时间里担任冒险学院院长的中年绅士……听到了很多经常在明珠港和天空之城公园出现的冒险学院院长阿尔有关的传闻。但是冒险学院是什么？他又是什么院长呢？真让人好奇……应该直接到阿尔院长那里问一下。
和传闻相比，阿尔院长是个给人印象很好的大叔。有好多想知道的事情啊……他让我做好心理准备之后再问他？再来问问他吧。
阿尔院长对冒险学院的热情和冒险经历非常了不起。虽然阿尔院长的冒险事迹很让人感动，但是我更感兴趣的是冒险学院本身…… 还好阿尔院长说关于冒险学院如果有什么问题的话，可以随时问他。我也要成为院长吗？不，还是先找到我可以帮助的同学再说吧。

en: #eJake, who works at the #eKerning Ciy Subway Turnstile, wants to ask you for a favor. You'd better go talk to him.\r\nTip - At the entrance of the subway station in Kerning City, you'll see Shumi sitting down in front.

废都地铁站的冬青向我请求帮助。他说在废都北部有个#e未完工的地铁站#n。因为收到报告，说那里出现了很多怪物，所以冒险岛地铁公司把#e林列车长#n派到了那里。他让我作为调查团，去那里进行调查。 到#e废都北方工地#n找到未完工的地铁站，和林列车长对话。
接受了在废都地铁站工作的冬青的委托，为了对未完工的地铁站进行调查，在废都北方工地找到了未完成的地铁站，见到了林列车长。接受了林列车长的请求，决定帮他对地铁的平台进行调查。

name.en: The Blocked Path of the Ocean

en: I should be able to see #p2060101# deep in the underwater... somewhere around #m230040400#.

I met #p2060101# in between #m230040400# at an empty ship that's been wrecked. He said he's been looking for the traces of his missing men. He came down here to check out the irregular activities that have been taking place here, and one day he lost contact with his men. Not only did he lose them, but he said the path to the bottom of the ocean is blocked too, so he asked me for help on looking for traces of his men. I should wander around looking for items that can be used as evidence. If the items the men have used are still here, then maybe the sharks that have been roaming around #m230040400# is the one to blame... I should find a flashlight, a camera and a notebook, and give them back to #p2060101#.

#p2060101#, whom I've met at #m230040400#, asked me to find traces of his men that have disappeared. I was able to gather up the flashlight, the camera, and the notebook that his men used at the time of the attack. Unfortunately, I wasn't able to find any of the missing men.

en: I heard that #p2032001#, who resides at the Cloud Park of #m200000000#, made a disturbing prophecy. She may not have the best of personalities, but she's a prophet who correctly saw the future. What must it be that she saw...?

name.zh: 海之风景：珂丽尔的建议

en: Kriel, a fairy that resides in Orbis, surely has never been underwater before, right? I mean, she has wings that are good for navigating the friendly skies, and definitely not for navigating underwater. Anyway, I should go see Kriel the Fairy.

Kriel, a proud owner of a set of wings, was blowing off travelers that weren't fortunate enough to have them. I don't think she has a clue that there are numerous breathtaking places that just cannot be reached by flying. According to Lisa, Kriel's not to enthused with the fact that she can only hear about the rumors of Aqua Road and not being able to go there in person. Anyway, Lisa suggested that I buy Kriel "The Official Aqua Road Photo Album" from Muse. Muse, huh... Another trip underwater... \n\n#i4031310# #t4031310#   #c4031310# / 1

I gave Muse 100 snow crystals and purchased the Official Aqua Road Photo Album, then gave it to Kriel for the viewing. After seeing her admit how beautiful Aqua Road is, I must say I felt validated by it, but it also seems like she set the whole thing up for this from the get go. Oh well, at least Kriel's happy, and that's good enough for me.

en: I heard something happened to Korin of Ludibrium... I better go check up on her.

I met a girl named Korin at a small house nearby Ludibrium. Korin had been missing for 10 months, and she did not remember anything that occurred during that time. I don't think he'd be at Ludibrium nor Eos Tower.

zh: 去地球本部找马斯特 将军

我收集齐20个水晶后给马斯特 将军了. 他说原来很温顺的打鼓兔子突然变成怪物的原因在这个水晶里.到底那个水晶里有什么秘密?

en: I should go visit General Maestro at the Omega Sector..

I met General Maestro, who's in command of a humongous army at the Omega Sector. The general said we'll be able to obtain the powerless, lightless #bDull Crystal#k that have been used up at the Eos Tower from #bDrum Bunnies#k. While most would dismiss the item as nothing more than a useless crystal, the general believed it had something important hidden in it, and that he requested me to gather up #b20 Dull crystals#k at the Eos Tower. I'll need to get those crystals from the Drum Bunnies at the tower.\n\n#t4031135# #b#c4031135##k/20

Just like the way General Mastro instructed, I went to Eos Tower, took out took out the Drum Bunnies, and gathered up #b20 Dull crystals#k for him. While looking at the crystal, he mentioned that there must be something inside these crystals to turn these previously-adorable Drum Bunnies to something of a menace. I wonder exactly what's inside it.

en: I should go visit General Maestro at the Omega Sector..

I met General Maestro, who's in command of a humongous army at the Omega Sector. The general said after investigating the dull crystals from the Drum Bunnies, he realized that the aliens may have a clue about this, and instructed me to find Alien Gray. There may be an item around Alien Gray that may provide clues for this. Of course, it won't just cough up the item, so I may have to look around the area where it's at. \n\n#t4031136# #c4031136#/1

Just like the way General Mastro instructed, I found a hidden document that appeared to have been purposely hidden Alien Gray. The general said, after putting the document through Alien Language Translator, it said a Dark Cryastal Ore with its dark force will turn a harmless doll into a monster. He wanted all the crystals gone before it gets too late.

en: Dark Tachion is an altered version of Tachion, which is the source of power that forms the Time Sphere. It should be deemed dangerous now, and since a creepy, evil force keeps seeping out of it, it must be a dangerous time here. I should destroy this at the lava deep in El Nath.

After taking care of Papulatus, it coughed up Dark Tachion, emitting a dark force in the process. To destroy this, I went to the deepest part of El Nath where the lava flows. I better destroy this by dropping it in the boiling lava.
After entering a hidden area where the lava flows, I found a Suspicious Lava. This is where I threw the Dark Tachion to destroy it. The force of evil disappeared along with the Tachion itself.

消灭帕普拉图斯之后从它身上出现了黑泰可因，为了破坏散发出邪恶力量的黑泰可因，来到了冰峰雪域深处的熔岩地下城。在这喷射出熔岩的地方，将它破坏掉吧。
找到熔岩地带中隐藏的空间，进入后看到了熔岩喷火口。将黑泰可因扔进那里销毁，邪恶的气息在一瞬间消失了。

name.en: Tae Gong's Love For His Wife

en: I should go visit Tae Gong, who's gone fishing floating around in the middle of Aqua Road.

Tae Gong, who's in the middle of the ocean fishing on a raft, was concerned that he couldn't gather up #t4000166# for his wife. I made a deal with him to gather up 20 #t4000166#s for him and deliver them to his wife Grandma Yeon at the Korean Folk Town.\n\n#t4000166# #c4000166#/20

Tae Gong, who was busy fishing in the middle of the ocean, requested that I gather up 20 #t4000166#s and deliver them to his wife Grandma Yeon, which I did. Grandma Yeon was very thankful, yet sorry that I had to go through all kinds of trouble just for her.

en: I better go visit Chil Sung at the Korean Folk Town.

Chil Sung and Chil Nam are brothers living in Korean Folk Town. Chil Sung was worried that his brother Chil Nam didn't have much food with him, and asked me if I could secretly place his sack of rice on Chil Nam's stacks.
I received a sack of rice from Chil Sung, and placed it on top of a stack of rice in front of Chil Nam's house.

住在童话村的七诚和七南是两兄弟。七诚说弟弟七南的粮食好像不够，托我把自家的一堆稻米悄悄拿到弟弟家前面的稻米堆中。
将七诚交给我的稻米放在了七南家院子内的稻米堆中。

en: Apparently, a Swallow hurt its wing and is laying down around the village shrine. I better go check it out ...

I met Swallow near the village shrine, its wings clipped. Swallow was on a delivery, but lost the item that it was suppose to deliver: a rare seed, and Swallow wanted me to find the seed for it. I met Swallow near the village shrine, its wings clipped. Swallow was desperate to find the lost seed, and asked me for help. en: Captain Hwang from Herb Town wants to tell you a creepy rumor about the Sea of Fog, located east of Herb Town. His story could be interesting. How about it, huh?

Captain Hwang from Herb Town tells you about the eastern route that connects Herb Town and Aqua Road. As the longest waterway in Maple World, this route passes through what is known as the "Sea of Fog", located east of Mu Lung Garden. He says there is a rumor that a ghost ship sails around this Sea of Fog.\r\nCaptain Hwang then suggests that you look for the ghost ship. He hints that you might be able to get some information from the Dolphin Taxi.

en: The palace of #m260000000# boasts a tight security, and doesn't let strangers in, but I really want to see what it's like inside... I should ask the head of the security at the palace, #p2101004#, for help.

#p2101004# told me flat out he can't let me in the palace... unless I show my allegiance towards Sultan by paying some mesos, then he'll give me a pass to the palace. ...2,000 mesos isn't much, but I feel like I'm just buying him off.

en: I remember seeing a boy sitting in the middle of the desert with a rose. He must not have been thirsty, because he kept worrying about the rose. I wonder if he's doing alright. I better go see him.

The strange boy was gazing up on the sky, then said to me in a sad tone, that he can't see a star. A star? What kind of a star is he looking at? I felt pretty sad watching him make a sad face wondering why he can't see a star, so I promised him I'll get #t4000333# from #o2100108# so he can see his star.  \n\n#i4000333# #t4000333#  #c4000333#/20

name.en: The True Identity of Sand Bandits

en: I have passed all the tests from all members of the Sand Bandits, and I have heard from each one of them that I deserve to be a member myself. Now I better head off to their secret residence.

The captain of the Sand Bandits, #p2101010#, told me I have done a good job passing all the tests, and told me a story about the Sultan and the queen of #m260000000#. After he was done with the conversation, he told me to look around #m260000000# once more, and let him know when I am ready.
I have finally become a member of the Sand Bandits through #p2101010#. As a member, my job is to do my best for #m260000000#.
zh: 通过了所有沙子图团员的考验，并且被他们认可了。现在去他们的秘密基地吧。
沙子图团团长扎诺说已经通过了所有团员的考验，讲起了关于#m260000000#的苏丹和王妃的故事。讲完故事之后，他看了一眼#m260000000#，说等下定决心进入沙子图团之后再来。
已经被扎诺认可进入沙子图团了。以后作为沙子图团员，要为#m260000000#而努力。

en: I have passed all the tests from all members of the Sand Bandits, and I have heard from each one of them that I deserve to be a member myself. Now I better head off to their secret residence.

The captain of the Sand Bandits, #b#p2101010##k, told me I have done a good job passing all the tests, and told me a story about the Sultan and the queen of #m260000000#. After he was done with the conversation, he told me to look around #m260000000# once more, and let him know when I am ready.
I have finally become a member of the Sand Bandits through #p2101010#. As a member, my job is to do my best for #m260000000#.

en: San Bandits are here to work for the residents of #m260000000#. Now that I am a member, I should get my first mission! I better talk to #p2101010#.

#p2101010# told me his plan is to steal an expensive order of silk that the queen planned to buy, and distribute them among the residents. The plan is, one of us will transform into the guard from the palace to receive the order of silk from the merchant and bring it back! He said as long as I get #p2101004#'s hair, then he'll make me a transformation potion. \n\n#i4031570# #t4031570# #c4031570# /1
I gave #p2101010# #p2101004#'s piece of hair... I mean, a piece of beard. Now I just have to wait for the potion to be completed... I wonder how this will work out.
zh: 为了#m260000000#居民而努力的沙子图团。成为了沙子图团员要接受任务了吧？去找扎诺吧。
扎诺说这次任务是把王妃想买的昂贵的丝绸秘密调出，分给人们。计划是，装成守卫王妃物品的警卫，把东西拿过来！只要拿来提干的头发，扎诺就可以制变身药。 #i4031570# #t4031570# #c4031570# /1
给了扎诺 提干的头发…… 不 提干的胡子。只要等变身药制成就可以了…… 会作成什么样呢？

en: #I promised p2101010#에 to get a piece of hair from #p2101004#, so I have to get one... so how am I going to do that? I better go see #p2101004#.
#p2101004# vehemently said no to hair, but agreed to give me a piece of his beard... as long as I give him 1 #t4010007#, a very expensive item...\n\n#i4010007# #t4010007# #c4010007#/1
I gave #p2101004# #t4010007#, and return, I got a piece of beard. It's not hair, but... it's still from the same body. I better go see #p2101010# right now.

给了提干 #t4010007#，拿到了一根胡子。虽然不是头发，但这个也应该没有问题吧？赶紧拿给扎诺吧。

en: Right about now, #p2101010# should be done with the Tigun Transformation Potion. I better go see #p2101010# right now.

I have received the transformation potion that allows me to change to #p2101004#. It looked odd, but I guess once I drink this, I'll look like #p2101004#. I better take the #p2101004#  transformation potion, head to #m260010600#, and steal some silk from #p2101013#.\n\n#i4031571# #t4031571# #c4031571#/1
I have received the queen's order of silk from #p2101004# and gave them to #p2101010#. Awesome! My first mission as a Sand Bandit complete!

从扎诺那儿得到了可以变身为提干的变身药。虽然很怪异，但既然说吃了之后可以变成提干，只能暂且相信了。赶紧吃提干变身药，去#m260010600#，从卡乐卡萨那儿拿丝绸吧。 #i4031571# #t4031571# #c4031571#/1
从提干那儿拿到了王妃订的丝绸，送给了扎诺。好！作为沙子图团员的第一个任务圆满完成了。

en: The first mission as a member of the Sand Bandits is to steal an order of silk that the queen ordered. Disguised as #p2101004#, I have to go to #m260010600# and get the order of silk from #p2101013#.
#p2101013# keeps giving me a suspicious look. Arrrghhh... I better talk well and just get the silk.
I finally got the silk from #p2101013#. Phew... it really is hard to pretend like someone else... anyway, since I succeeded, I better return to #p2101010#!
zh: 作为沙子图团员，正在执行第一个任务…… 任务是抢夺王妃订的丝绸！以提干的模样去#m260010600#，与王妃做丝绸生意的 卡乐卡萨那儿拿到丝绸。
卡乐卡萨以怀疑地眼神看着。呜呜…… 要好好说话，拿到丝绸。
好不容易从卡乐卡萨那儿拿到了丝绸。呼，模仿别人真不是一件容易的事啊…… 还好成功了，去找扎诺？

en: I've been here at #m260000000# for a while... suddenly, #p2101005# contacted me, wanting to meet up with me. What is it?

#p2101005# told me I am now ready to make the job advancement, and told me he wanted to recommend me to #p1022000# of Victoria Island. I better take Byron's Recommendation Letter and go see #p1022000#.
I showed #p1022000# the recommendation letter written by #p2101005#. #p1022000# told me he trusts #p2101005#'s opinions, and told me to drop by whenever I am ready to make the advancement.
zh: 来#m260000000#也有一段时间了…… 正好巴一岚说想见见我。是什么事呢？
巴一岚说到了该转职的时候了，要向金银岛的武术教练推荐我。拿着巴一岚的推荐书去找武术教练吧。
把巴一岚给的推荐书拿给武术教练了。武术教练说巴一岚的推荐值得信任，如果想转职的话，可以随时来找他。

name.en: A Proper Reward for a Good Deed
name.zh: 对于善行的适当的补偿

en: I got bamboozled by a Red Scorpion, thinking I was helping Sand Bandits out. Good thing I noticed it before it went on for too long, and I stole some from their treasures and gave them out to others. I feel great about it, but for some reason, Sirin wanted to talk to me about it.

Sirin told me I have done more good deeds that made up for helping out the Red Scorpions, and that she said it's okay for me to look for some compensation from this. Compensation? Who's going to pay me?
As a small compensation for all that, I took some from the treasure chest. This should be enough.
zh: 被声称沙子图团的红蝎子团骗，反而帮了红蝎子团。幸好及时发现并把红蝎子的宝物分给了村子里的人，现在心安理得了…… 但不知为什么西琳还有话要说……
西琳说做了这些事早已弥补了帮助红蝎子团的事件，可以适当的要求些补偿。补偿？是谁给补偿呢？
作为善行的补偿，拿了几个宝物箱中的宝物。嗯，这个算是适当的补偿吧。

en: I got bamboozled by a Red Scorpion, thinking I was helping Sand Bandits out. Good thing I noticed it before it went on for too long, and I stole some from their treasures and gave them out to others. I feel great about it, but for some reason, #bSirin#k wanted to talk to me about it.

Sirin told me I have done more good deeds that made up for helping out the Red Scorpions, and that she said it's okay for me to look for some #bcompensation#k from this. Compensation? Who's going to pay me?
As a small compensation for all that, I took some from the treasure chest. This should be enough.

en: I've been in this #m260000000# for quite a while, when #p2101005# contacted me, asking for a meeting. I wonder what this is about...
#p2101005# said that it's time for me to advance to a new job; he's going to recommend me to #p1090000# in Victoria Island. I should bring Byron's Recommendation to #p1090000#.
Upon seeing #p2101005#'s recommendation, #p1090000# said he would trust anyone who comes recommended #p2101005#, and I should come to him to change my job whenever I want.

name.zh: 智由拉的宫殿出入资格证

en: #p2101001# says he is going to see his sister.  I'm worried since he's just a kid.  Maybe I should go see him.

I didn't really believe it when #p2101001# said he was going inside the palace to see his sister... The plan #p2101001# thought of was to buy #t04031582# from #p2101004#.  Since I already said I would pay for it knowing that #p2101001# has no money... I guess I need to keep the promise now.\n\n#i04031582# #t04031582#  #c04031582# / 1

#p2101001# looked so happy when he received the #t04031582# ... Then just like that, he ran off to the palace.  I'll have to ask him later if he was able to meet his sister.  But... was he supposed to write his name on the #t04031582#?  I've never heard of that before.

[CN]#t04031582#을 받고 너무 좋아하는 智由拉... 어? 어느새 궁전으로 달려가 버렸다. 좀 이따가 누나하고 잘 만났는지 물어봐야겠다. 근데... #t04031582#에 이름을 쓰는 거였나? 그런 이야기는 처음 듣는데?

en: I feel bad for #p2101001#.  He really wanted to get in the palace...  I should step in and try to convince #p2101004#.  A fine of 50000 mesos... I'll pay it off instead and ask for him to let #p2101001# to meet his sister.\n\n50000 mesos

name.en: In Search of the Long Lost Pyramid

en: Byron, who studies the everyday life of the desert people of the Ariant Back Street, says that he's found something strange in the desert. You should go visit Byron.\r\nTip - Take the ship from Orbis heading toward Ariant, the oasis of Nihal Desert.

Byron claims that a huge sandstorm recently covered the path between Ariant and Magatia and completely changed the landscape of the area, revealing a #emysterious Pyramid#n. He's currently seeking explorers willing to help unlock the mysteries surrounding the Pyramid. First up, you'd better head over to Sahel 3 and talk to #eDuarte#n, who stands near the Pyramid.

As Byron requested, you headed to Sahel Desert in search of the giant, mysterious Pyramid. At its entrance stood Duarte, who warned about the dangers of the Pyramid, but opened its doors to any who dare risk their lives to unlock its mystery.
zh: 在#e阿里安特后街研究沙漠居民生活的文化学者巴一岚说最近在沙漠中有了新的发现。去见见巴一岚。 提示 在天空之城搭乘开往阿里安特的飞艇，可以到达尼哈沙漠的绿洲阿里安特。
在阿里安特地区从事研究工作的文化学者巴一岚说最近在阿里安特通往玛加提亚的沙漠中，在一次规模巨大的沙尘暴之后，有一座#e身份不明的金字塔#n露了出来。他说他正在寻找探险家，对这个充满了疑团的金字塔进行调查。为了揭开金字塔的秘密，先去沙哈地带3见见金字塔前面山丘上的#e杜阿特#n。
接受了在阿里安特研究沙漠民族文化的文化学者巴一岚的委托，前往沙哈沙漠，对最近一次沙尘暴之后出现的巨大的金字塔进行调查。站在金字塔入口处的杜阿特警告了金字塔的危险性，说如果是不怕死的勇士的话，可以继续挑战……

en: There's a Masked Man in New Leaf City... what's his deal?

I spoke with Jack Masque, he's a bandit prince from Amoria. He's in love with Princess Restless, and is trying to win her love from afar. He's got a passionate hatred for Wolf Spiders, as one bit her just as she was giving him a kiss. So, I've agreed to hunt down 100 Wolf Spiders in return for his thanks and something special he picked up. I should be able to find them in the MesoGears...

+Phew* I wiped out 100 of those pesky Wolf Spiders, and in return, I received a Leaf Crystal from Jack Masque. I can come back every 72 hours to help him if I want. I wonder what he did to get kicked out of Amoria...?

name.zh: 苏巴尼的遗产 - 发现

en: I heard there's an adventurer over at the MesoGears underneath Bigger Ben. What mysteries does it hold? I should find out!

I spoke with the famous John Barricades' one-half of the world famous Barricade Bros. Treasure Hunting Co. He spoke to me about Subani, the legendary mage responsible for the Dark Scrolls throughout the Maple World. He believes there is something within the MesoGears that may be a treasure of his. I've agreed to help clear the way. I'll have to defeat 50 Killa Bees, 30 Mighty Maple Eaters and 40 Fire Tusks so I can explore deeper into the MesoGears...
I cleared a path straight through the MesoGears, and now I can explore there in peace. When I'm ready, I can see John Barricade to continue with the next part of this adventure!
zh: 我听说有个冒险者藏在大大本钟下的秘宝齿轮里。他都知道些什么秘密呢？是时候去一探究竟了！
我和巴里凯德兄弟寻宝公司的扛把子约翰·巴里凯德谈过了。他跟我讲述了在冒险岛世界散落无数黑暗卷轴的传奇
我清出了通向秘宝齿轮的道路，终于能不受打扰地探索了。准备好之后去见约翰·巴里凯德就能继续这场冒险！

en: John Barricade is awaiting me at the Temple Hive! He's found something!

I spoke with John, and he's found a set of weird markings in the MesoGears that he can't decipher. He's mentioned that he'll need special crystals known as Hyper Glyphs. I've agreed to snag 50 of them so he can decipher the markings. Electrophants...John thinks that the mechanism on their heads may have those Hyper Glyphs inside. I'd better be careful-I don't want to get shocked!
I got the 50 Hyper Glyphs that John needed, and he's hard at work deciphering the markings. I should come back soon to see if he's finished!

en: There's a mysterious traveler in New Leaf City-he doesn't look like he's from anywhere around here. I should ask him what's going on. It could be interesting...

I spoke with Elpam Gorlab, and he's a traveler from Versal, the mirror-world of MapleStory. He traveled here to observe us and our celebration, but due to the appearance of Amoria, he was thrown off-course and landed in New Leaf City. I've agreed to help get him home by collecting 30 Elpam Magnets. He's mentioned that the only creatures that have them here are the Barnard Grays. I'll have to head to Omega Sector and track them down. I didn't know that there was a mirror-world...I wonder if I have a double there...
I got the 30 Elpam Magnets and returned them to Elpam. In return, he gave me an Elpam Elixir, something that's sure to help me. It looks like he needs more help though...

I spoke with Icebyrd, and he was glad to see me. He's been trying to build the new areas, but the Gryphons have been wreaking havoc on the construction crews. If that wasn't enough, those pesky Boomers are also attacking the machines. I've agreed to help by taking out 100 Gryphons (located in the Highlands) and Boomers for 150 #t4000391# (located in the Badlands) to show them that this city is off-limits!

en: Looks like the Glimmer Man is looking for a rare material from the alternate dimension of Versal, the very #t4031760# that I now possess.  Perhaps I should visit him in New Leaf City and see what he wants with it.  Maybe he'll reward me for bringing him some...

I visited the Glimmer Man, and discovered that he's an ultra-powerful mage whose ability to turn his entire body into pure diamond (hence his name) has allowed him to journey to space and other inhospitable environments.  Through the vast knowledge he's acquired during his explorations, he's also become somewhat of a renowned weapons creator and arms dealer.\r\nThe Glimmer Man has landed in Masteria looking for something called #t4031760#, a rare element from the alternate dimension of Versal he's been dying to experiment with.  To thank me for recovering some and bringing it to him, he's promised to make me a weapon of my own from it. However, I've got to also track down 7 #t4021008#s and return these to him as well.  Only then can he reduce the naturally unstable Materia down to a useable form.  A weapon made from an otherwordly material! I wonder what it does...

I returned to the Glimmer Man and he synthesized the #t4031760# and the 7 #t4021008#s I gave him to form a Materia Orb.  He's said his precocious friend Spindle can turn this into a weapon, so I should see him when I'm ready to make the weapon...WOOT!  Spindle is currently residing in the Omega Sector.  Additionally, anytime I find more White Versal Materia, I can bring it to the Glimmer Man and he'll create another Materia Orb for me so I can make another weapon!

en: Looks like the Glimmer Man is looking for a rare material from the alternate dimension of Versal, the very #b#t4031760##k that I now possess.  Perhaps I should visit him in New Leaf City and see what he wants with it.  Maybe he'll reward me for bringing him some...

I visited the Glimmer Man, and discovered that he's an ultra-powerful mage whose ability to turn his entire body into pure diamond (hence his name) has allowed him to journey to space and other inhospitable environments.  Through the vast knowledge he's acquired during his explorations, he's also become somewhat of a renowned weapons creator and arms dealer.\r\nThe Glimmer Man has landed in Masteria looking for something called #b#t4031760##k, a rare element from the alternate dimension of Versal he's been dying to experiment with.  To thank me for recovering some and bringing it to him, he's promised to make me a weapon of my own from it. However, I've got to also track down #b7 #t4021008#s#k and return these to him as well.  Only then can he reduce the naturally unstable Materia down to a useable form.  A weapon made from an otherwordly material! I wonder what it does...

I returned to the Glimmer Man and he synthesized the #b#t4031760##k and the #b7 #t4021008#s#k I gave him to form a Materia Orb.  He's said his precocious friend Spindle can turn this into a weapon, so I should see him when I'm ready to make the weapon...WOOT!  Spindle is currently residing in the Omega Sector.  Additionally, anytime I find more White Versal Materia, I can bring it to the Glimmer Man and he'll create another Materia Orb for me so I can make another weapon!

en: I keep seeing these fireplaces around the house. I wonder if they lead anywhere...maybe Edmunds knows?  He mentioned something about a key.  I should press him a bit more.

My hunch was right.  The fireplaces are interconnected through the mansion's Chimney; perhaps I can use them as an alternate way of navigating through the house.  However, they're locked and Edmunds holds the only key.  He will reluctantly give me the key if I collect 20 of each type of Gummy Slimes. I spoke with one of the vendors, and in return for my Allowance, I received a Nexon Game Card! I can also take this to any of the Store Vendors in Henesys, Amoria, or New Leaf City if one store happens to be sold out. I can help Mom and Dad everyday until the end of the event, receive Allowance and get another Nexon Game Card. I should get as many as possible, because when the event ends, it will turn into MaplePoints that I can use in the Cash Shop! Free money! WOO HOO!

en: There's a little girl with a puzzled look on her face in New Leaf City.  With X-mas time just around the corner, she should be happy... I wonder why she looks so puzzled and confused instead?  Looks like she may need some help with her Maplemas spirit!

Little Suzy was all excited for Maplemas this year... until she learned all about a similar holiday called "Versalmas" from a strange green mouse named O-Pongo.  Now she doesn't know what sounds more exciting - Maplemas... or Versalmas?  Suzy needs my help to help her decide which version of X-mas she should celebrate this year.  In order to do that, I'll have to speak to both Maple Claws and this O-Pongo character, and then come back and talk to her.  Maplemas holiday from an alternate dimension, huh?  Very curious...

I spoke to both Maple Claws and O-Pongo.  It seems that both Maplemas and Versalmas have their merits.  In the end, Suzy's put the decision on me: she's asked me to deliver her X-mas Wishlist to one of the two "Santas," which will determine which holiday she's celebrating this year.  I have a feeling that this decision is important, that I'm not just making a choice for her... but also one for myself.  Which holiday do I believe in?

en: To help her decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, Little Suzy wants me to go talk to O-Pongo.  I'd better speak with this strange green mouse and find out more details about Versalmas.
To help Little Suzy decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, I spoke to O-Pongo about Suzy's dilemma.  O-Pongo listened and asked me to deliver a message to Suzy.  I should talk to her in a bit.

Versal Power! I spoke with O-Pongo, the Versalmas Mouse, who is the "Santa" for the Versal version of Maplemas, and learned a great deal about Versalmas.  He told me about the customs for their holiday--quite different from the Maple World! The world of Versal is usually shrouded in darkness; Versalmas is an annual holiday that celebrates the emergence of the sun in their world, which shines for 90 straight days and only for these 90 days.  For Versalmas, children receive presents every day for the first 30 days, and get cool treats like Sugar-coated Olives and Caramel Onions! Sounds pretty awesome... Now I'd better speak with Maple Claws and head back to Suzy... It makes me wonder for myself though, which holiday would I pick to celebrate?  Hmmm...

en: Now that I have Little Suzy's Wishlist, I need to give it to either Maple Claws or O-Pongo.  I'm thinking I should give it to Maple Claws; I should go see her in Happyville.

I can give Little Suzy's Wishlist to Maple Claws.  In doing so, she'll be counting on me to help me recover her presents for her this year.  All I have to do now is to give Maple Claws the list to cement my decision. Yes... it's going to be a very Merry Maplemas this year!

I thought that Maplemas was the better holiday so I gave Little Suzy's Wishlist to Maple Claws.  In return, she gave me a red Maplemas Hat that I can wear proudly to show my Maplemas Spirit!  Every time I help Maple Claws recover the presents stolen by monsters, she'll reward me; I'll now be able to redeem presents with her in batches of 10, 20, 30, 40, 60, 90, or 100.  I'll get different rewards at different tiers; the more presents I bring at one time, the better the rewards!  I'll need to bring her presents appropriate to my level though.\r\nBringing Maple Claws more presents will also help me earn Maplemas Spirit!  If the total amount of Maplemas Spirit accumulated on my world beats out the total amount of Versalmas Cheer, Maple Claws will have a special something for me at the end of the event!a

en: The keeper of the Aquarium, #p2060005#, is researching a way to tame and possibly ride monsters. I should take a trip to Aqua Road and see if there's anything I can do to help!

#p2060005# found out that someone is trying to steal his research.  #p2060005# asked me to  watch the wild boar and bring back #t4031508# to him.  On top of that, he asked me to get the wild boar's #t4031507# as well...I'd better stay alert for this one--I don't want someone to steal his research before I learn how to tame and ride monsters! 

#i4031508##t4031508# #c4031508#/5
#i4031507##t4031507# #c4031507#/5.

I obtained the items and returned to the Aquarium. For helping him with his research, #p2060005# gave me the monster riding skill and one #t1912000# for the monster. It's time to travel in style! I must look in the Tiger Ridge map, there should be some rubble lying about--a hidden portal. Traveling through it will transport me to a new area with the pigs. I can use the perfume when I'm close to one to capture it. After that, I can equip the Mount and the saddle, and use my new Monster Riding skill to call the mount! en: I was finally able to learn the "Maker" skill through Meren. Awesome!! Does this mean I can make something right now from scratch? But... where should I start? While I was standing there not knowing what to do, that was when a man came up to me to tell me something. That man happened to be Meren's friend and a legend in the field of making Monster Crystal, Ramain.

Ramain works with Meren and happens to be known as the master of producing Monster Crystals. He's a nice fellow, but his stuttering makes him really hard to understand. Anyway, after watching me being unsure of myself what to do with the skill, he offered to teach me how to produce a Monster Crystal. He then asked me to make one right there on the spot...\n\n#i4260000# #t4260000# #c4260000# / 1

Ramain, the master of producing Monster Crystals who is Meren's coworker, taught me how to produce a Monster Crystal. It was a bit difficult to understand him due to his constant stuttering, but it was very helpful. Then, he asked me to make one right there on the spot, challenging me to make 1 #t4260000#, the easiest Monstery Crystal to make. After making one, Ramain took a look at it, and commended me for my effort. Hah! Does this mean I can be considered an Item Producer now?

拉玛人是威尔斯的同事，也是著名的怪物结晶制作大师。人虽然很亲切，但却有点让人郁闷。他看到我学会锻造技术之后，因为不知道该制作什么东西而彷徨，于是告诉了我制造怪物结晶的方法。让我尝试亲手制作怪物结晶…… #i4260000# #t4260000# #c4260000# / 1

en: When I told Papulatus that I had come from the future, he seemed very interested in learning more about me. I guess he got even more excited when I told him that he, in the future, was doing some pretty major things... Little does he know that he's doing some pretty radical, negative things... Anyway, how am I supposed to get back to the future now?

Papulatus asks me to be his guinea-pig for the research he's been working on, which is almost complete. He says he'll send me back into the future where I came from... I don't like the idea that I'm a guinea-pig for his research, but I can't stay in the past like this forever. I guess I should trust Papulatus for now and get back to the future to tell Rolonay about what had happened.
I don't know if it's a remnant of the power I felt during my transition between dimensions but I've somehow acquired the power to control space and time. I'll call this skill 'Time Lift'.
zh: 看我的样子像是从未来来的，帕普拉图斯听我讲话听得津津有味。大概是听说自己在未来要做大事所以更加兴奋了……虽然好像是在做什么有别的意义的大事，但是不管怎么样,我要怎样才能又回到之前生活的世界呢？
帕普拉图斯请求说为了完成研究请让他成为实验对象。并承诺会亲自送我回之前的世界……说什么实验对象这话听起来心里总有点惴惴不安，但是要我就这么待在过去里还真的不行。就相信帕普拉图斯，等回到我来之前的时代再把这个事情转告天书爷爷吧。
大概是因从在时空的缝隙里受到了某种奇怪力量的影响，有那么短短一会儿我手中充满了能够调节时空的力量。这种技巧称为“伺机待发”。

en: After countless battles... the goddess has prepared something for me. I better go visit the Statue of Goddess at Orbis.

The statue was always silent, but all of a sudden, I could hear a voice. The goddess told me as a person that has reached the highest level that is available, and challenged me to step up and put in the effort to help others. She told me to let her know of my decision. Hmm...

I received a new skill from the Goddess called the Echo of the Hero. This isn't for my own benefit, but for everyone else around me. The statue, which always had a sad face on, seems to be smiling as I look at it once more.
zh: 无数的战斗之后…… 为了成为冒险岛的最强者的您，女神有一个准备好的礼物。去天空之城，找找女神的雕像吧。
一向安静的女神雕像开始有声音了。作为一个人类，已经到达了最高的境界…… 现在需要可以为更多人奉献的神力，如果做好心理准备的话，请向女神宣誓吧。
女神赐予了新技能，英雄的回音。不仅是为自己的，而是为了所有人类的技能…… 一贯是悲伤表情的女神的脸中仿佛能看见淡淡的微笑。

en: After countless battles... the goddess has prepared something for me. I better go visit the Statue of Goddess at Orbis.

I received a new skill from the Goddess called the Echo of the Hero. This isn't for my own benefit, but for everyone else around me. The statue, which always had a sad face on, seems to be smiling as I look at it once more.

Lukan asked if I knew anything about the unfriendly Stormbreaker warriors wandering the forest.  He seems to hate them, though strangely, his armor looks almost exactly like theirs... lightning bolts and all!  Regarding this, Lukan remains tight-lipped... at least until I prove I'm not in league with them.  To gain his trust, and prove my fighting prowess, I need to defeat these Stormbreakers and collect 10 of their badges to bring to him.

After defeating the Stormbreakers as he requested, Lukan explained that he is a Stormcaster Knight from Crimsonwood Keep.  When I told him that Crimsonwood Keep was ancient history, and that Masteria had been lost for a millenium, he seemed at a loss for words.  Somehow, he has been transported to this time period, his future.  Strange things are brewing indeed.

I fulfilled Taggrin's request and brought him the fallen seeds from the Phantom Trees.  He seemed to warm up to me for doing this, and has opened the bandit's camp up to me.  Now I can buy and sell things from their provisioner, Mo.  Whew, this has definitely saved me the effort of having to trek all the way back to NLC!

en: Jack Barricade has given me the Map of Phantom Forest that he took from Taggrin.  He explained that he was forced to steal it from Taggrin, who had refused to give it to him even after he'd won it in a bet fair and square.  Now that Jack's made it up to the Crimsonwood Mountain, he's given the map to me for my own use.  Perhaps I should return it to Taggrin?  If I keep it, the map will come in handy while navigating the tricky Phantom Forest, allowing me to use the marked shortcuts and save time traveling.  But at the same time, there's a part of me that feels that this map still rightfully belongs to Taggrin.  What should I do?  It's a dilemma...

I told Taggrin that I'd found Jack up the Crimsonwood Mountain, and explained Jack's purpose.  Taggrin was surprised when I offered to return his Map of Phantom Forest to him... and was moved by my gesture. He seems to have warmed up to me, and ask that I return and speak to him. What could he want?

In return for making the honorable gesture of returning his map, Taggrin let me in on a secret of his own: he and his band are not bandits at all, but are actually Raven Ninjas, descendants of the ancient Shadowknights!  They're here to discover what happened to their ancestral Keep and the reason behind the disappearance of Masteria.  As such, Taggrin is offering a bounty on the Keep's unrightful occupiers.  I can now speak to Joko to redeem any Badges I find off these corrupted warriors (the Windraiders, the Stormbreakers, the Firebrands, and the NightshadowsRk) for meso bounties, and possibly even Raven Ninja gear!  I can make one Badge Bounty Redemption per day

en: I should speak to Taggrin to see if he has another task for me.

Taggrin has one more task for me: he wants me to hunt down the Elder Wraiths and collect 50 of their Elder Ashes.  Warning me that this would be no easy task, he explained that the wraiths are the souls of brave Crimsonwood Keep warriors who fell in battle in the forest, protecting the Keep from the invading Krakians.  Never given a proper burial, they have become mindless undead, threatening the Keep's foes and innocent travelers alike.  With these ashes, Taggrin intends to give these noble lost souls the final rest they so rightfully deserve.

Taggrin was impressed that I manage to collect the ashes from the Elder Wraiths.  I can now speak to Fiona about upgrading any Raven Ninja gear I may have!  Taggrin also mentioned that the talented ninja smith has experimented with some weapon designs of her own; I should speak to her about the possibility of crafting new items from scratch.

en: I should see if Jack Barricade needs my help with anything...

Jack needs John's help, and needs me to be the go-between.  He wants me to deliver a letter to his brother in NLC; the Coded Communique contains a transcription of some strange symbol code that he saw while being held in Crimsonwood Keep.  Hopefully, with his expertise in ancient languages, John should be able to decipher it.  I should hop to it!  I have a feeling some serious events are unfolding...

Looks like Jack was right about the symbols he saw in the Grandmaster Council Hall; the Versalian code seems to indicate that the new Masters are planning to attack NLC with the soldiers they're training!  It's going to be up to us to stop them!

en: With all the strange occurrences in Masteria and New Leaf City, Lita Lawless must be busy! I'll bet that she's willing to accept my help...maybe I can earn some mesos in the process! A quick jaunt to the Kerning City subway and I'll be on my way to New Leaf City!

I spoke with Lita, and it looks like there a trickster roaming about the Phantom Forest. It caused her quite a bit of trouble-surprising for a warrion of her caliber. I've agreed to help rid the Forest of these nefarious creatures, and as proof, I have to bring her 30 of the strange silver clovers-she called them Lucky Charms. I'll be on guard-that forest is haunted...or so I've heard...

I ventured into the maddening Phantom Forest and came into contact with a number of the Leprechauns and after a series of battles, got 30 Lucky Charms. I returned them to Lita for the Bounty! She thanked me for my help, and mentioned that I can return to her for more bounty work!

I spoke with Lita, and I'm pretty sure I'm getting the short end of the stick on this one. I have to venture into the Phantom Forest and find this creature they've named Bigfoot and claim its toe as the proof of bounty. Everyone else who's gone after this thing has never come back-I'd better stock up on potions and keep my guard up-who knows when it could appear?

I found this mysterious creature, and Lita wasn't kidding when she said it wrecked everyone that came after it! Although, when I was fighting it, I got the feeling that the Leprechaun on its back was just luring him into things...maybe it just doesn't know better? At any rate, I returned the Toe to Lita and claimed the Bounty.  The more mesos, the better!

en: It's time for Thanksgiving and I'm ready for some home cookin'! I should pay Mom and Dad a visit over in Henesys!

They promised me an #t4031529# if I return quickly. I guess the Turkeys stole all the ingredients to make Thanksgiving fixins'... I guess they think that without the fixins', there'll be no dinner!  No dinner?  No way!  Time to defeat some battle-hardened Turkeys!

en: There's a little girl with a puzzled look on her face in New Leaf City.  With X-mas time just around the corner, she should be happy... I wonder why she looks so puzzled and confused instead?  Looks like she may need some help with her Maplemas spirit!

Little Suzy was all excited for Maplemas this year... until she learned all about a similar holiday called "Versalmas" from a strange green mouse named O-Pongo.  Now she doesn't know what sounds more exciting - Maplemas... or Versalmas?  Suzy needs my help to help her decide which version of X-mas she should celebrate this year.  In order to do that, I'll have to speak to both Maple Claws and this O-Pongo character, and then come back and talk to her.  Maplemas holiday from an alternate dimension, huh?  Very curious...

I spoke to both Maple Claws and O-Pongo.  It seems that both Maplemas and Versalmas have their merits.  In the end, Suzy's put the decision on me: she's asked me to deliver her X-mas Wishlist to one of the two "Santas," which will determine which holiday she's celebrating this year.  I have a feeling that this decision is important, that I'm not just making a choice for her... but also one for myself.  Which holiday do I believe in?

en: To help her decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, Little Suzy wants me to go talk to O-Pongo.  I'd better speak with this strange green mouse and find out more details about Versalmas.
To help Little Suzy decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, I spoke to O-Pongo about Suzy's dilemma.  O-Pongo listened and asked me to deliver a message to Suzy.  I should talk to her in a bit.

Versal Power! I spoke with O-Pongo, the Versalmas Mouse, who is the "Santa" for the Versal version of Maplemas, and learned a great deal about Versalmas.  He told me about the customs for their holiday--quite different from the Maple World! The world of Versal is usually shrouded in darkness; Versalmas is an annual holiday that celebrates the emergence of the sun in their world, which shines for 90 straight days and only for these 90 days.  For Versalmas, children receive presents every day for the first 30 days, and get cool treats like Sugar-coated Olives and Caramel Onions! Sounds pretty awesome... Now I'd better speak with Maple Claws and head back to Suzy... It makes me wonder for myself though, which holiday would I pick to celebrate?  Hmmm...

en: Now that I have Little Suzy's Wishlist, I need to give it to either Maple Claws or O-Pongo.  I'm thinking I should give it to Maple Claws; I should go see her in Happyville.

I can give Little Suzy's Wishlist to Maple Claws.  In doing so, she'll be counting on me to help me recover her presents for her this year.  All I have to do now is to give Maple Claws the list to cement my decision. Yes... it's going to be a very Merry Maplemas this year!

I thought that Maplemas was the better holiday so I gave Little Suzy's Wishlist to Maple Claws.  In return, she gave me a red Maplemas Hat that I can wear proudly to show my Maplemas Spirit!  Every time I help Maple Claws recover the presents stolen by monsters, she'll reward me; I'll now be able to redeem presents with her in batches of 10, 20, 30, 40, 60, 90, or 100. #p2012011#은 전대 #t1032040#의 소유자에 대해 이야기해 주었다. 인간이면서 드물게도 요정의 친구였던 그... 크리엘 역시 그와 친분이 있었던 모양인데... 과거의 기억 때문일까? 크리엘은 #o3230200# 50마리를 잡고 #t4000059# 30개를 가져다 준다면 #t1032040#에 고대 요정의 축복을 걸어 주겠다고 말했다.

en: 카산드라가 의뢰하고 싶은 일이 생겼다고 한다. 마을에 있는 카산드라를 찾아가보자.

카산드라는 요즘 각 마을에서 일어나고 있는 이상한 일에 대해 말해주었다. 겨울이 시작되면서 마을 어딘가에 누가 만들었는지 알 수 없는 정체불명의 눈사람이 세워지고 있다고 한다. 단순히 눈사람이라면 상관없겠지만, 이 눈사람은 살아 움직이면서 마을 사람들에게 장난을 치고 있다고 하는데... 마을 사람들은 골칫거리인 눈사람을 퇴치해 주면 보상을 해주기로 약속했다면서 나에게 이 일을 해보지 않겠냐고 제안했다.\n\n#o9500319# #a99521#
마을 사람들의 골칫거리인 거대 눈사람을 퇴치했다. 하지만 녹아서 사라지고 있는 눈사람을 보고 있자니, 눈사람은 단지 사람들과 놀고싶었던 것이 아닌지... 눈사람이 없는 겨울이 너무 쓸쓸하지는 않을까하는 생각이 들었다.
zh: 听说星缘有事情想委托我。去找村子里的星缘。
星缘讲述了最近各个村子里发生的奇怪事件。入冬后，村子里也不知道谁在什么地方堆出了奇怪的雪人。如果是一般的雪人也就罢了，但这个雪人活了过来，并在村子里四处捣蛋……村民们表示谁要是能击退令人头疼的雪人就给予奖赏，于是星缘问我愿不愿意去。 #o9500319# #a99521#
击退令村民头疼的巨大雪人。然而看着不断融化的雪人，突然觉得也许雪人也不过是想跟人类一起玩而已……没有雪人的冬天会不会太过冷清呢？

en: 거대 눈사람을 퇴치하고, 눈사람의 나뭇가지를 줏었다. 그런데 왠지 따뜻한 느낌이 드는 이유는 뭘까?
거대 눈사람을 퇴치하고 바닥에 떨어진 눈사람의 나뭇가지를 줏어드는 순간, 행복한 마을에 있던 나뭇가지 눈사람으로부터 나뭇가지를 가지고 찾아와 달라는 전언이 왔다. 나에게 해주고 싶은 이야기가 있다고 하는데... 행복한 마을로 찾아가 봐야할 것 같다.
행복한 마을에 있는 나뭇가지 눈사람은 마을에 나타난 꼬마 눈사람에 대해 이야기 해줬다. 장난이 심하긴 했지만, 사람들을 좋아하던 꼬마 눈사람을 미워하지 말아달라면서 나뭇가지에 깃든 눈의 마법으로 루돌프의 뿔에 새로운 마법을 깃들게 해주었다.
zh: 击退了巨大雪人，捡起雪人的树枝，却不由得感到一阵温暖。
击退巨大雪人后，捡起掉在地上的雪人的树枝的一瞬间，我接到了幸福村的树枝雪人让我拿着树枝去找它的传话。据说是有话要对我说……看来我得去一趟幸福村了。
幸福村的树枝雪人讲述了有关村子里出现的雪娃娃的事情。虽然雪娃娃很喜欢捉弄人，但树枝雪人希望人类不要讨厌它们，毕竟它们是喜欢人类的。树枝雪人用树枝里的雪之魔法向圣诞鹿的角内注入了新的魔法。

오늘의 미션을 완료했다.

en:
Today's Mission!!
<Earn 50 points on the Speed Quiz!>

Today's mission is to get 50 points from the Speed Quiz.  If you go see Agent Cassandra, you can take a speed quiz on the items and monsters of Maple World.  You get 1 point per question and the quiz can be taken once every 30 minutes.  You must earn a total 50 points for today.
Today's mission has been completed.

en: I lost the Parachute Agent Shoes that Gaga gave to me recently during his suspicious offer.  I feel bad asking for another pair now, but should I still ask Gaga?

곤란한 표정의 카산드라가 하고 싶은 이야기가 있어 보인다.

카산드라는 요즘 가가가 너무 기운이 없는 것 같다면서 재미가 하나도 없다고 투덜댄다. 그 동안 많이 골려 먹었지만, 요새처럼 기운이 하나도 없는 가가는 재미가 없다나? 가가가 기운을 차릴 수 있도록 행운의 부적으로 알려진 '행운의 흰 원숭이 인형'을 모아다 주라고 부탁하면서 절대로 가가에게 미안해서 그러는 것이 아니라고 강조했다.\n\n#i4032087# #t4032087# #c4032087# / 10

카산드라는 요즘 가가가 너무 기운이 없는 것 같다면서 재미가 하나도 없다고 투덜댄다. 그 동안 많이 곯려 먹었지만, 요새처럼 기운이 하나도 없는 가가는 재미가 없다나? 카산드라의 부탁으로 가가가 기운을 차릴 수 있도록 행운의 부적으로 알려진 '행운의 흰 원숭이 인형'을 모아서 가져다 주었다.\n카산드라는 절~대 가가에게 미안해서 그러는게 아니라고 하지만 진심은 아닌 것 같다. 가가는 인형을 받고 행운이 찾아올지도 모른다고 기대하는 것 같다. 가가에게 정말 행운이 왔으면 좋겠다. 가가는 행운은 나누는 것이라며, 무엇이 나올지 모르는 두근두근 상자를 선물로 주었다.

en: 어렸을 적 가가가 받았던 크리스마스 선물은 뭘까? 따뜻한 집에서 행복하게 보낸 크리스마스의 추억을 그리워하는 가가에게 가 보자.
가가에게 크리스마스의 추억을 떠올릴 수 있는 물건을 가져다주자! 가가가 어렸을 적 받았던 선물을 모아 가가에게 가져다주면 보답을 하겠다고 한다. 어떤 물건이었지? 으음... 이번에는 어쩔 수 없네. 기억이 안 나면 가가에게 다시 가서 물어보는 수밖에...
가가가 부탁한 선물을 찾아 주었다. 어릴 적의 행복했던 크리스마스를 회상하느라 마음이 여유로워진 가가는 손수 만들었다는 루돌프의 빨간코에만 붙일 수 있는 특제 반창고를 주었다. 다시 갖고 싶은 선물이 또 있었는데...라고 중얼거리는 가가를 보니 다음에 말을 걸면 또 다른 선물을 부탁할 것만 같다. 10분 후에 다시 와 봐야지...
zh: 佳佳小时候收到的圣诞礼物是什么呢？佳佳非常怀念在温暖的家里度过的圣诞时光，去见见他吧。
去搜集可以让佳佳回想起小时候的圣诞节的东西吧！搜集佳佳小时候收到的礼物交给佳佳，就可以得到报酬。是什么东西呢？嗯……这下可没办法了。想不起来的话，就只能再回去问问佳佳了……
找到了佳佳想要的东西。佳佳回想起小时候幸福的圣诞时光，心情变得好多了。他送了我一个可以贴在圣诞鹿的红鼻子上的特制OK绷。我还想要其他礼物……佳佳自言自语地说。看来重新和他说话的话，他又会让我去寻找别的礼物。等10分钟之后再来吧……

en: 어렸을 적 가가가 받았던 크리스마스 선물은 뭘까? 따뜻한 집에서 행복하게 보낸 크리스마스의 추억을 그리워하는 가가에게 가 보자.

가가가 부탁한 선물을 찾아 주었다. 어릴 적의 행복했던 크리스마스를 회상하느라 마음이 여유로워진 가가는 손수 만들었다는 루돌프의 빨간코에만 붙일 수 있는 특제 반창고를 주었다. 다시 갖고 싶은 선물이 또 있었는데...라고 중얼거리는 가가를 보니 다음에 말을 걸면 또 다른 선물을 부탁할 것만 같다. 10분 후에 다시 와 봐야지...

zh.note: 第三方官方语料（国服译名/原版阶段文本），待抽审

name.en: The 2010 Winter King / Winter Queen Event!

en: Winter is here, and the chilly cold is already affecting everyone! If you wish to become the Winter King or Winter Queen of 2010, you'd better go see Cassandra.

en: According to #p1101002#, I can take my Knighthood Exam if I go see #p1101003#, the Chief Knight of Light. I better head over to Ereve and meet #p1101003#.

The Knighthood Exam has started. The test itself is actually quite simple. I just need to reach the end of the Training Forest, enter the 2nd Drill Hall, and defeat the Tiguru inside while bringing back #t4032096#. I better find 30 #t4032096#s and bring them back to #p1101003#. \n\n#i4032096# #t4032096# #c4032096# / 30

en: According to #p1101002#, I can take my Knighthood Exam if I see #p1101007#, the Chief Knight of Lightning. I better head over to Ereve and meet #p1101007#.

The Knighthood Exam has started. The test itself is actually quite simple. I just need to reach the end of the Training Forest, enter the 2nd Drill Hall, and defeat the Mimis inside while bringing back #t4032100#. I better find 30 #t4032100#s and bring them back to #p1101007#. \n\n#i4032100# #t4032100# #c4032100# / 30
I have successfully completed the Knighthood Exam and officially dropped the "in-Training" from my title. As a bonafide Cygnus Knight, I shall do my best to keep everything lighthearted and fun.
zh: 南哈特说可以在闪电骑士团长胡克那里接受骑士等级考试。去圣地见见胡克吧。
骑士等级考试开始了。内容很简单，只要去修炼森林尽头的第二演武场，击退那里的提提，把#t4032100#带回来就行。搜集30个#t4032100#，然后回去见见胡克。 #i4032100# #t4032100# #c4032100# / 30
骑士等级考试结束了。现在修炼骑士的身份已经结束，我被任命为正式骑士。作为冒险骑士团的正式骑士，在任务中寻找快乐吧。

en: According to #p1101002#, I can take my Knighthood Exam if I see #b#p1101007##k, the Chief Knight of Lightning. I better head over to Ereve and meet #p1101007#.

I just need to reach the end of the Training Forest, enter #bthe 2nd Drill Hall#k, and defeat the Mimis inside while bringing back #t4032100#. I better find #b30 #t4032100#s#k and bring them back to #p1101007#. \n\n#i4032100# #t4032100# #b#c4032100# / 30#k

en: #p1101002# is contacting me in an emergency manner. I wonder what happened.
Something terrible must have happened at Ereve. I better go find out.
According to #p1101002#, an important item from Ereve has been stolen by one of the minions who serves the Black Mage. What must that be? I better head over to Ereve.
zh: 突然收到了南哈特发来的信……
圣地好像出了什么问题。快去看看吧。
南哈特说有件重要的东西被黑魔法师的手下偷走了。到底丢了什么呢？快去圣地看看吧。

en: #p1101002# is contacting me in an emergency manner. I wonder what happened.
Something terrible must have happened at #bEreve#k. I better go find out.
According to #p1101002#, an important item from Ereve has been stolen by one of the minions who serves the Black Mage. What must that be? I better head over to Ereve.

zh.note: 第三方官方语料（国服译名/原版阶段文本），待抽审

en: The detailed instructions on searching for the thief will be given by #p1101003#, the Chief Knight of Light. I better talk to #p1101003#.

Apparently, the member of the Black Wings has yet to escape Ereve. If we just search the island thoroughly, we may be able to find the culprit. First, I'll need to visit #p1101002# and receive a Investigation Permit, followed by a thorough search of Ereve to find #o9001009#. Once I find him, I'll need to defeat him in a battle and bring back #t4032101# in the process. The problem is that the enemy, being the #o9001009#, is adept at transforming into different persons, so I better talk to each and every one of them to figure out who's real or fake. 

#o9001009# #a203011# 
#i4032101# #t4032101# #c4032101# / 1
I was able to defeat #p1104001# the #o9001009#, a member of the Black Wings, and managed to recover #t4032101#.

据说黑色之翼还没能离开圣地，仔细搜索的话，应该能找到他的踪迹……从南哈特那里领取搜索证，搜索圣地，找出并击退#o9001009#，找回#t4032101#吧。但敌人既然是#o9001009#，他会变身成其他人的样子，所以要通过对话分辨是真的还是假的。 #o9001009# #a203011# #i4032101# #t4032101# #c4032101# / 1

en: So it seems that if I want to conduct a thorough search on Ereve in search of the Master of Disguise, I'll have to first receive a Investigation Permit. I better talk to #p1101002#.

He claims that due to handing out too many Investigation Permits in times like this, the Investigation Permits have actually run out. He then asked me if I could get him some #t4005004#s so he can issue new Investigation Permits...
I wound up giving #p1101002# some #t4005004#s, and received a Investigation Permit in return. It's now time for me to conduct a thorough search of Ereve.
zh: 要搜索圣地，找出变身术士，必须首先领取搜索证。去和南哈特对话吧。
他说由于同时有太多的骑士领取搜索证，搜索证全都发光了，让我帮他搜集制作新搜索证所需的#t4005004#。
把#t4005004#交给了南哈特，领取了搜索证。现在可以在圣地自由地搜索了。

en: I lost the #t1912005# for Mounts. What should I do...? I better talk to #b#p1102002# the Mount Trainerk# for help.

#p1102002# told me because of budget issues, he couldn't give me a spare #t1912005#, and told me I must come up with a new #t1912005# on my own... It is rumored that #p2060005# of #m230000000# is a great maker of #t1912005#s... but I have a feeling it's going to be very expensive. I'll have to bring the materials and the service charge for the #t1912005# to #p2060005#.
I handed #p2060005# the materials for #t1912005#, along with the service charge, and received #t1912005# in return. I better make sure not to lose #t1912005# ever again.

en: I lost #t1902005#. What should I do? I better talk to #p1102002# the Mount Trainer about this situation.

#t1902005# is a fantasy creature that naturally dissolves if it stays away from its master for a prolonged period of time. In short, if I want #t1902005# back, I'll have to awaken the creature from the egg stage, starting over from scratch. #p1102002# said he can get the Supplements for me, but I'll have to pay for it again... sigh. I'll have to rack up enough experience to awaken #t1902005# once more.
I was able to awaken #t1902005# once more. I better not lose it again.

en: So, you follow #p1201000#'s instructions and look in the Mirror of Desire once more. Your vision gets dark for a second, but then you find yourself in #m211000000#, once again returning to the past. Standing before you is a Yeti in tears. What's going on? You'd better talk to #p1203001#.

en: Something must be wrong with the #p1201002#. What's going on, you wonder? Why is he in so much pain?

#p1201002# confesses that, because he spent the last few hundred years without a master, the hint of darkness that existed in his heart has begun to spiral out of control in the form of rage. He's begging you to get rid of the rage. Apparently, if you defeat #p1201002#, the rage will stop. It doesn't look easy by any means, but it is what a master must do. You'd better take on the #o9001014#.\r\n\r\n#o9001014# #a214011#
You were able to defeat the #o9001014#. Once the rage subsided, #p1201002# helped awaken more of your past powers.

摩诃说由于在几百年时间内没有主人，内心产生的黑暗偶尔会暴走，并让我阻止暴走。只要打倒摩诃，暴走就会停止……虽然看上去不太容易，但这是主人应该做的事情。阻止#o9001014#吧。 #o9001014# #a214011#
打倒了#o9001014#。在停止暴走的摩诃的帮助下，找回了相当一部分过去的力量。

#p1002104# says that ever since he got ambushed by the #o9300346#s, he's been using any means necessary to find the Seal Stone. He feels that holding on to the Seal Stone would be dangerous, so he wants to store it in #b#m140000000##k, the deserted island. I'd better deliver the #bSeal Stone to #p1201000##k.

#t4032323#. No one knows what its purpose is, but it is obvious that Black Wings want it. Desperately. You can't let that happen… Just as you're thinking this, #p1201000# hands you a new skill called the #bCombo Drain#k.

en: You lost the Seal Stone of Orbis. What does this mean? Head to #m104000000# and talk to #p1002104# to get some advice.
After explaining to #p1002104# everything that took place in #m200000000#, #p1002104# felt that this information should be relayed to #p1201000# as well.

#p1201000# seemed glad to have discovered that the Black Wings are after the Seal Stone and that there's more than one Seal Stone out there. She encouraged you with motivating words, then taught you a new skill that she had just decoded, known as the Combo Smash.

en: When you reach Level 63, #p1002104# sends you a message.

According to #p1002104#, one of the clocktowers in #m220000000# has broken down. This clocktower manages time, and when it broke, it somehow created a path to the past. en: Just as #p1002104# instructed, you use the #m220000000# clocktower to travel to the past. Just as you arrive in the past, someone calls out your name…

#p2131002# seems shocked to see you and greets you like a long-lost sibling. Do you know this person? While you stand there dumbfounded, #p2131002# tells you that #p2131000# is also waiting for you, and that you should make your way to the Camp Conference Room to let #p2131000# know that you are alive and well.
You finally met #p2131000# in Ellin Forest. #p2131000# seemed glad to see you alive and well, but then learned that you have no recollection of the past and seemed sad to hear it.
zh: 按照特鲁所说的方法，通过#m220000000#时间塔来到了过去。突然有人和我说话……
友里索吃了一惊，但马上又变得非常高兴，说原来战神还活着。是认识我的人吗？就在我不知所措的站在那里的时候，友里索说赫丽娜也在等待着战神。快去营地会场见见赫丽娜，告诉他你还活着吧。
在艾琳森林见到了赫丽娜。赫丽娜非常高兴，说看到战神还活着真是太好了。但是得知我什么事情都不记得了之后，他一脸悲伤。

name.en: The Lost Seal Stone of Ellin Forest
name.zh: 被抢走的艾琳森林的封印石

en: It turns out that the Seal Stone of Ellin Forest was taken by #o9300353# of the Black Wings. How did this happen? You'd better go talk to #p2131000# in Ellin Forest.

#p2131000# reveals that she has a letter that contains information about another Seal Stone and promises to hand it to you. Unfortunately, you can't take the letter since #p2131000# and you are from two separate times. \n\nJust when you think it's all over, #p2131000# tells you that she's a fairy with a very long life, and that she will in fact carry the letter to your time. What you need to do now is leave Ellin Forest and meet #p2131000# in your own time. You wonder where #p2131000# is? You'd better ask #p1002104#.

You asked #p1002104# whether he knew anyone named #p2131000#. It turned out that #p1002104# is one of the most well-known people in all of Victoria Island. You should head to #m100000201# in #m100000000# to meet Athena Pierce at the Bowman Instructional School.
zh: 艾琳森林的封印石被黑色之翼的#o9300353#拿走了。怎么办呢？和艾琳森林的赫丽娜谈谈吧。
赫丽娜说自己那里有一封写着其他封印石的情报的信，他说可以把信交给我。但是我却没办法拿到那封信……因为我和赫丽娜是属于两个不同时代的人。 赫丽娜说自己是可以活很长时间的妖精，说会在我那个时代把信交给我。只要离开艾琳森林，在原来的时空里找到赫丽娜就行。赫丽娜在哪儿呢？去问问特鲁吧。
问特鲁认不认识一个名叫赫丽娜的人，特鲁说那不是金银岛很有名的一个人吗，并告诉我赫丽娜就在#m100000000##m100000201#。快去弓箭手培训中心见见赫丽娜吧。

en: It turns out that the Seal Stone of Ellin Forest was taken by #o9300353# of the Black Wings. How did this happen? You'd better go talk to #b#p2131000##k in Ellin Forest.

#p2131000# reveals that she has a letter that contains information about another Seal Stone and promises to hand it to you. Unfortunately, you can't take the letter since #b#p2131000# and you are from two separate times#k. \n\nJust when you think it's all over, #p2131000# tells you that she's a fairy with a very long life, and that she will in fact carry the letter to your time. What you need to do now is leave Ellin Forest and #bmeet #p2131000# in your own time#k. You wonder where #p2131000# is? You'd better ask #b#p1002104##k.
