en: You met #p1204031# in the #m100000201# of #m100000000#. Thankfully, the letter hadn't gotten lost, but you think #p2131000# must have been shocked to see you. You'd better to talk to #p2131000#.

#p1012100# flashed a big smile, saying that she knew she'd someday meet you again. She then handed you the letter. It's a great feeling, knowing that you have a friend that remembers you hundreds of years later. You'd better show the letter to #p1002104#.

#p1002104# tells you that the letter is unreadable and that it actually might be cursed. He recommends that you show #p1201000# the letter. Since she seems to be good with spells, she might be able to break the curse.
zh: 在#m100000000##m100000201#遇到了#p1204031#……还好信没被抢走，但是赫丽娜一定会很吃惊。去见见赫丽娜吧。
赫丽娜说知道我一定会去找她的，她笑着把信交给了我……过了好几百年时间，还有人记得我，真的让我很感动。把从她那里拿到的信交给特鲁吧。
特鲁说信上好像施有孽咒，无法阅读，让我拿去给利琳看看。利琳对咒术也很精通，应该可以解除孽咒。

en: You can't read the letter given by #p2131000#. What is this, anyway? You'd better head over to #m104000000# and ask #p1002104# what to do with it.
According to #p1002104#, the letter is written in a secret code. Thankfully, you have a master decoder in #p1201000#, so take the letter and head over to #m140000000#.
#p1201000# said that decoding the letter may take some time and told you she'll let #p1002104# know once it's complete.
zh: 从赫丽娜那里拿到的信好像无法阅读。怎么回事，这封信？去#m104000000#问问特鲁吧。
据特鲁说，这封信好像是用暗号写成的，应该是为了保密而采取的措施。还好利琳应该可以解读暗号，快带着信到#m140000000#去吧。
利琳说解读信需要一点时间，解读好了之后，会通过 特鲁和我联系。

en: When you reach Level 68, #p1002104# send a message.

Apparently, #p1201000# succeeded in decoding the letter and it contains some surprising information! Better head over to #m140000000# immediately and talk to #p1201000# about the contents of the letter.
Amazingly, the letter written by the heroes was addressed to the Queen of the time. The actual content of the letter simply asked that the Queen take good care of the Seal Stone of #m130000000#.
zh: 达到68级之后，特鲁突然和我说话。
利琳好像成功地解开了信上的孽咒！但是信的内容非常让人吃惊……快去#m140000000#见见利琳，确认信的内容吧。
信是英雄们写给当时的女皇的，内容是嘱咐要好好保管#m130000000#的封印石。

en: Now that you know what's written in the letter… what should you do? You'd better go to #m140000000# and talk to #p1201000#.

#p1201000# says that it's essential to warn #m130000000# about the Seal Stone and writes a letter urging them to protect it at all cost. Your job is to go to #m130000000# and hand the letter to the Queen, but with that annoying strategist of the Queen, Neinheart, blocking the way, it might be difficult. Maybe you should just talk to the Strategist instead.
You met the Queen's strategist, #p1101002#. He took the letter and told you he'd take it into consideration, but his eyes tell you otherwise.
zh: 知道了信的内容。现在该怎么办呢？去#m140000000#问问利琳吧。
利琳说必须去#m130000000#转告封印石的事情，让他们保护好封印石，并把整理好的信交给了我。好像只要到#m130000000#去把信交给女皇就可以了……但如果那个挑剔的策士也在，可能很难见到女皇。应该先去和南哈特谈谈。
见到了女皇的策士南哈特。他收下了信，说会对信的内容进行慎重的讨论和研究。怎么看上去有点不太可靠啊？

en: #p1101002# is sending you a message…
#p1101002# thanks you for protecting the tears of the Divine Bird and wants to give you a reward for it. You'd better head over to #m130000000#.
As a token of his appreciation, #p1101002# taught you a new skill and mumbled that he hoped you might one day join forces with him. That smile of his seemed to convey a million subtle meanings.
zh: 南哈特突然和我说话……
南哈特对我表示感谢，说多亏有了我提供的情报，才守护住了神兽的眼泪。他说想送我一件礼物作为报答……去#m130000000#看看吧。
南哈特对我表示感谢，并告诉了我一个技能。南哈特说将来说不定需要和我联手……但是他的笑容看上去很可疑。

Apparently, #p20000# started displaying some strange behavior ever since he started carrying some wooden box with him. Your task now is to investigate the wooden box that's next to #p20000#.
As you promised to #p20000#, you did not reveal to #p1002001# that the wooden box contained medication for arthritis.
zh: 特奥说约翰最近很奇怪，去见见明珠港的特奥，看看发生了什么事。
他说约翰自从身边多了一个木箱之后，行动就变得很奇怪。必须对约翰旁边的木箱进行调查。
按照和约翰的约定，没有告诉特奥木箱里装的是关节炎治疗剂

You find unidentified medication inside the box.

It turned out that #p20000# had been taking his own special arthritis medicine behind #p1002001#'s back. You made a deal with him, promising not to tell anyone about the contents of his wooden box in exchange for a small reward. You shouldn't tell #p1002001# about the wooden box. Just make something up.
zh: 应该接受特奥的委托，对约翰经常带在身边的木箱进行调查。
在木箱里发现了不明的药物。
约翰说这段时间一直背着特奥，偷偷服用特殊的关节炎治疗剂。作为保守秘密的报酬，得到了一些礼物。对特奥，就凑合着应付一下吧。

Extra extra! Happyville is holding an amazing party for Maplemas! For more details, please go see Rooney.

zh: 要举行圣诞派对啦～！
好消息～幸福村要开办非常有意思的派对。详细的内容去找露妮确认噢～

en: A secret note came from the Snow Spirit of Happyville. I wonder what happened?

I finally realized the true intent of the Snow Spirit as she strives to protect Happyville from disaster. In order to ruin Scrooge's plan, she asked Alcaster of El Nath for some much needed help. I better go find him immediately!
I gave Alcaster a note from Snow Spirit. Now it's time for me to wait for his reply.
zh: 从幸福村的雪精灵那里收到了秘密的纸条。幸福村到底发生了什么事情呢……
知道了雪精灵想要守护幸福村的意图。她为了阻止克洛斯的计划，向冰峰雪域的阿尔卡斯特请求了帮助。快去见见
把雪精灵的纸条交给了阿尔卡斯特。接下去就是要从他那里得到答案了。

en: Alcaster says he has something for Snow Spirit.
He handed me a reply letter to Snow Spirit, a note that contains the exact method we should take to defeat Scrooge. I better go see her right now!

I gave the Snow Spirit Alcaster's reply letter. She stood quietly for a moment, then gave me something called Force of the Spirit, which she said was the key to defeating Scrooge. What exactly is this?

Protect the snowman from Scrooge and his men!
I was able to protect the symbol of luck here in Happyville, the giant snowman. That really made my day.
zh: 听说克洛斯终于来实施自己的计划了。快去见见雪精灵吧。

en: I think it's about time Icebyrd gave me some answers...I should go speak with him.
I've spoken with Icebyrd, and he seems cryptic-what is he hiding?

Icebyrd has revealed the truth to me at last-he was contacted by Subani to establish New Leaf City as well as anchor Masteria to the Maple World.  He was sworn to secrecy, and to this day, can never leave the continent.  It appears that Subani and Icebyrd are the first line of defense against the demonic Naricain, and by defeating his Twisted Masters; I am now his enemy as well.  He also mentioned that our adventures here have just begun...with the Twisted Masters out of the way, what's next?  Perhaps answers lie within the Krakian Jungle, and the mysterious city there...only time will tell!
